lines.text: Nora ran out of water an hour from the car, so she ate a handful of snow.
Soon she was colder than before.
Your body burns its own heat to melt snow, and a handful is barely a sip of water.
Carry enough water for the whole hike, keep the bladder inside your pack against your back, and sip at every break, even when you're not thirsty.
Save this before your next winter hike.
